caption: The drawing depicts an object made of dark metal, resembling iron, placed against a plain, light-colored background. The base consists of three rounded, petal-like sections forming a clover shape, with three curved legs extending downward for support. Emerging from the center is a coiled metal spring that rises vertically. Attached near the top of the spring is a bent metal wire that arches upward and outward, ending in another smaller coil. Hanging from this wire is a rectangular metal tag with a hole through which it is suspended. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the object’s color is a dark, almost blackened brown with areas showing highlights that suggest metallic reflections. The background is untextured and unobtrusive, emphasizing the central object. Small printed or drawn text appears just beneath the object.
title: Spiral Iron Candle Holder
